# Software

<p class="lede">Web applications, pipelines, R packages and tutorials, from clinical mitochondrial genetics to scheduling and field-guide keys. Most are on <a href="https://github.com/leipzig">GitHub</a>.</p>

<div class="sw-grid">
<a class="sw-card" href="https://mitomap.org/mitomaster/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/mitomaster.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>Web Application</span></p>
    <h3>MITOMASTER</h3>
    <p>Web application that allows clinicians to quickly investigate mitochondrial mutations in sequenced or genotyped samples. Used worldwide for mitochondrial genetics research.</p>
  </div>
</a>
<div class="sw-card">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/mybic.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>Django/Python</span></p>
    <h3>myBiC</h3>
    <p>Django application that manages user authentication and presentation of bioinformatics deliverables. Streamlines report delivery for core facilities.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="sw-card">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/insipid.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>Pipeline</span></p>
    <h3>InSiPiD</h3>
    <p>Integration Site Pipeline and Database - comprehensive toolset for managing viral integration site data processing, annotation, and analysis.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<a class="sw-card" href="https://web.archive.org/web/20051227140854/http://statgen.ncsu.edu/asg/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/alternative-splicing-gallery.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>PHP · 2004</span></p>
    <h3>Alternative Splicing Gallery (ASG)</h3>
    <p>Searchable web gallery of splicing graphs for human genes, built from Ensembl, UniGene and EST alignments. Each graph shows every alternative transcript at once, colors cassette exons, intron retentions and competing splice sites, and lets you pick exons to assemble a transcript sequence.</p>
  </div>
</a>
<a class="sw-card" href="../rhylthyme/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/rhylthyme.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>Python · 2025</span></p>
    <h3>Rhylthyme <span class="badge">Case study</span></h3>
    <p>A JSON-based markup language and toolchain for describing real-time programs that coordinate parallel tracks of work with resource constraints, timing dependencies, and flexible execution patterns. Includes a CLI runner, web visualizer, and MCP server for AI-assisted schedule generation.</p>
  </div>
</a>
<a class="sw-card" href="https://leipzig.github.io/dimoose/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/dimoose.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>R · 2020</span></p>
    <h3>dimoose</h3>
    <p>R package for dichotomous identification keys. Build a key from a plain spreadsheet with photos, draw it as a box diagram, or turn it into an offline web wizard for the field; also imports FishBase keys and generates keys from photos (CLIP/BioCLIP), sequence alignments and trait matrices. Includes an illustrated key to Montana&#x27;s native broadleaf trees.</p>
  </div>
</a>
<a class="sw-card" href="https://github.com/leipzig/awesome-reproducible-research">
